messages.content: The airline changed our May 26 return and now shows only 34 minutes in Denver. Is that actually a valid connection, and is it realistic with my partner's knee? Please compare the later flight and the next-morning option before changing anything.

The airline still labels the 34-minute DEN connection as valid, so it can be ticketed as offered. In practice, it is very tight: boarding for the Minneapolis flight would already be underway when you land, gates may be in different concourses, and even a small delay from San Jose could cause a misconnect. The mobility note does not guarantee a cart or that the onward flight will be held.
What does each alternative look like in full, including the extra costs we already know about?

Option 1 keeps the revised 34-minute connection and the current May 26 arrival time, with no added fare, hotel night, or car day. Option 2 keeps the same May 26 SJC-DEN segment but moves you to the later DEN-MSP flight, arriving Minneapolis at 11:40 p.m.; there is no airfare increase and no Monterey hotel or rental extension because you still leave San Jose as scheduled. Option 3 moves both return segments to May 27 for $176 total. Extending Cypress Cove and the rental one night adds $264 combined, making the next-morning option $440 more overall.
How much connection time would we have on the later same-day flight, and would our checked bags be moved automatically?

The later flight gives you 2 hours 46 minutes in Denver. The tickets remain on one itinerary, so checked bags would be tagged through to Minneapolis and transferred by the airline. You would not need to collect them in Denver.
Then the later same-day flight is the sensible choice. Please change only the return connection. Do not touch the outbound, inn, or rental car.

Understood. I will retain the May 20 MSP-DEN-SJC outbound, the May 26 SJC-DEN return segment, Cypress Cove through May 26, and the existing SJC rental return. Only the DEN-MSP segment will move to the later flight arriving at 11:40 p.m., with no fare difference.
Go ahead and confirm that change for both of us.

The return change is confirmed for both travelers. On May 26, the SJC-DEN segment remains unchanged, followed by a 2-hour-46-minute connection and the later DEN-MSP flight arriving at 11:40 p.m. There was no additional airfare. The May 20 outbound, Cypress Cove reservation, ground-floor room note, and SJC rental reservation were not changed. The trip total remains $3,720.

The SJC rental remains reserved from May 20 at 12:45 p.m. through May 26 at 11:30 a.m. The December 13–16, 2027 Charlotte and Richmond client trip remains confirmed. The Nashville April 2027, central Oregon coast September 2027, Denver October 2027, and San Diego November 2026 trips remain booked. The coastal Georgia trip and separate January 2027 Denver client trip remain unbooked. The Raleigh breakfast refund and corrected folio, Philadelphia deposit release and shuttle details, and an earlier Nashville refund reconciliation remain unresolved.
